name: RPG Maker MV/MZ and other NW.js games
author: Cell
summary: Games built on NW.js (Chromium) draw inside the game process, so the window doesn't stay black. WebGL keeps using the graphics card.
useWhen: An RPG Maker MV/MZ (or other NW.js) game opens a black window.

notes: NW.js is Chromium: its separate GPU process can't draw into the game's window under Wine on macOS.
